Planning a New Zealand South Island road trip? This part of our journey covers some of the most beautiful places in New Zealand — from the magical blue waters of Lake Pukaki and Lake Tekapo to the scenic drive towards Queenstown
In this video, we continue exploring the breathtaking South Island and visit famous attractions like the Lake Pukaki Visitor Centre, lavender fields, Church of the Good Shepherd, Clay Cliffs, and many hidden scenic stops along the road to Queenstown.
